# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Document if a partial brake test has been conducted, or if it was impossible to conduct a brake test for any reason (i.e. if the trailer ABS / EBS might be faulty).
3. Document the following in Part 5 of the records:
4. Document the make, model and VIN of the vehicle.
5. Indicate if the wheel brakes did not pass the brake test or if they could not be checked (i.e. if the diesel-powered auxiliary diesel heater was turned off).
6. If the brakes fail, indicate how many axles have brakes and document the failure.
7. Document the date of discovery and the time when the vehicle inspection records must be completed.<eos>
